evidence: This is a flat ground terrain patch (grass tiles) filling rows 0..47, which is appropriate for the 'terrain' kind.

style.evidence: The candidate repeats a single sparse 16x16 grass tile across the 4x3 grid. Most of each tile (including regions larger than 6x6 pixels, e.g., rows 6..15, cols 6..15) is a single flat mid-green fill (#578d37) with only a few isolated 3-5 pixel tufts. Even compared to the simplest Beodeul grass tile (which has subtle 2x2/4x4 checker dither and varied tuft tiles across the patch), this has large unvaried flat fills and repetitive stamps.
